meta.copyright_note: All works are in public domain (author death 50+ years)

books.author: 吴承恩
books.description_zh: 讲述孙悟空、猪八戒、沙僧保护唐僧西行取经，历经九九八十一难的神话故事。
books.description_en: The story of the monk Xuanzang's pilgrimage to India with his disciples Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing.

books.author: 曹雪芹
books.description_zh: 以贾宝玉与林黛玉的爱情悲剧为主线，展现贾府的兴衰历程。
books.description_en: A tragic love story between Jia Baoyu and Lin Daiyu, depicting the rise and fall of a wealthy family.

books.author: 罗贯中
books.description_zh: 描述东汉末年到西晋初年近百年的历史风云，刘备、曹操、孙权三国争霸。
books.description_en: An epic tale of the power struggle between the three kingdoms of Wei, Shu, and Wu in ancient China.

books.author: 施耐庵
books.description_zh: 讲述一百零八位好汉聚义梁山泊的故事，反映农民起义。
books.description_en: The story of 108 outlaws who gather at Mount Liang to form a sizable army.

books.title_english: Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio
books.author: 蒲松龄
books.description_zh: 收录近500篇神鬼妖狐故事，是中国古典文言短篇小说的巅峰之作。
books.description_en: A collection of nearly 500 supernatural tales involving ghosts, foxes, and immortals.

books.author: 紫式部
books.description_zh: 世界上第一部长篇小说，描写平安时代贵族光源氏的一生与爱情故事。
books.description_en: Often considered the world's first novel, following the life and romantic adventures of Prince Genji.

books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.description_zh: 穷学生拉斯科尔尼科夫杀害放高利贷的老妇后，内心的挣扎与救赎。
books.description_en: The mental anguish and moral dilemmas of Raskolnikov, who plans and executes a murder.

books.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
books.description_zh: 以1812年拿破仑入侵俄国为背景，描写俄国贵族家庭的命运。
books.description_en: An epic novel set during Napoleon's invasion of Russia in 1812.

books.author: 维克多·雨果
books.description_zh: 讲述苦刑犯冉·阿让的救赎之路，反映19世纪法国社会底层人民的苦难。
books.description_en: The story of Jean Valjean's redemption and the plight of the poor in 19th-century France.

books.author: 简·奥斯汀
books.description_zh: 伊丽莎白·班纳特与达西先生的爱情故事，讽刺英国乡绅阶层的婚恋观。
books.description_en: The romantic comedy between Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy, satirizing Georgian society.

books.author: 清少纳言
books.description_zh: 日本最早的随笔文学，记录平安时代宫廷生活的所见所感。
books.description_en: A classic collection of observations and musings from the Heian court.

books.author: 佚名
books.description_zh: 讲述平安末期源平合战，平家一族兴衰的军记物语。
books.description_en: An epic account of the struggle between the Taira and Minamoto clans.

books.title_english: The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter
books.author: 佚名
books.description_zh: 日本最古老的物语文学，讲述月宫公主辉夜姬的故事。
books.description_en: Japan's oldest prose narrative about Princess Kaguya from the Moon.

books.author: 大伴家持 编
books.description_zh: 日本最古老的和歌总集，收录4500余首诗歌。
books.description_en: The oldest existing collection of Japanese poetry with over 4,500 poems.

books.author: 紀貫之 编
books.description_zh: 第一部敕撰和歌集，确立了日本诗歌的美学标准。
books.description_en: The first imperial anthology of Japanese poetry, establishing aesthetic standards.

books.author: 吉田兼好
books.description_zh: 日本古典随笔三大杰作之一，探讨人生无常与美学。
books.description_en: A collection of essays on life, beauty, and the impermanence of things.

books.author: 鴨長明
books.description_zh: 日本隐逸文学经典，反思人世无常与简朴生活。
books.description_en: A meditation on impermanence and simple living by a Buddhist recluse.

books.title_english: The Narrow Road to the Deep North
books.author: 松尾芭蕉
books.description_zh: 俳圣芭蕉的北国旅行记，将俳句与散文完美结合。
books.description_en: Bashō's poetic travel journal through northern Japan.

books.author: 上田秋成
books.description_zh: 日本怪谈文学杰作，九篇鬼魅妖异的故事。
books.description_en: A masterpiece of Japanese supernatural fiction with nine eerie tales.

books.title_english: The Life of an Amorous Man
books.author: 井原西鶴
books.description_zh: 日本町人文学开创之作，描绘浮世男女的情欲世界。
books.description_en: A pioneering work of Japanese popular fiction about urban pleasures.

books.author: 但丁·阿利吉耶里
books.description_zh: 但丁穿越地狱、炼狱、天堂的灵魂之旅，中世纪文学巅峰。
books.description_en: Dante's journey through Hell, Purgatory, and Paradise, the pinnacle of medieval literature.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 丹麦王子哈姆雷特为父复仇的悲剧，探讨生死与存在。
books.description_en: The tragedy of Prince Hamlet's revenge for his father's murder.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 蒙太古与凯普莱特两个世仇家族的子女相爱的悲剧。
books.description_en: The tragic love story of two young lovers from feuding families.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 苏格兰将军麦克白在野心与女巫预言的驱使下弑君夺位。
books.description_en: A Scottish general's ambition leads him to murder the king.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 摩尔将军奥赛罗被嫉妒蒙蔽，杀死无辜妻子的悲剧。
books.description_en: The Moorish general Othello is manipulated into murdering his innocent wife.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 年迈的李尔王将王国分给女儿们后遭到背叛的悲剧。
books.description_en: An aging king divides his kingdom among his daughters and faces betrayal.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 雅典森林中仙王与精灵的魔法，交织人间恋人的纠葛。
books.description_en: Magical fairy mischief entangles the lives of Athenian lovers.

books.author: 威廉·莎士比亚
books.description_zh: 被流放的公爵普洛斯彼罗用魔法在孤岛上制造风暴复仇。
books.description_en: An exiled duke uses magic to shipwreck his enemies on his island.

books.author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
books.description_zh: 浮士德博士与魔鬼梅菲斯托订约，追求知识与生命意义。
books.description_en: Dr. Faust makes a deal with the devil in pursuit of knowledge and meaning.

books.author: 约翰·沃尔夫冈·冯·歌德
books.description_zh: 青年维特爱上已订婚女子洛蒂，最终自杀的悲剧。
books.description_en: A young artist falls hopelessly in love with a woman engaged to another man.

books.author: 米格尔·德·塞万提斯
books.description_zh: 骑士堂吉诃德与侍从桑丘的荒诞冒险，讽刺骑士小说。
books.description_en: The adventures of a delusional knight and his squire, parodying chivalric romances.

books.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
books.description_zh: 已婚贵妇安娜与青年军官沃伦斯基的婚外恋悲剧。
books.description_en: The tragic affair between a married aristocrat and a dashing cavalry officer.

books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.description_zh: 卡拉马佐夫三兄弟与其父的冲突，探讨信仰、自由意志与道德。
books.description_en: Three brothers and their conflicted relationship with their father.

books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.description_zh: 纯真善良的梅什金公爵进入腐败的彼得堡社会的故事。
books.description_en: The saintly Prince Myshkin enters the corrupt society of St. Petersburg.

books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.description_zh: 描写俄国虚无主义革命者的破坏性活动与精神世界。
books.description_en: A portrayal of nihilistic revolutionaries and their destructive ideology.

books.author: 尼古拉·果戈理
books.description_zh: 骗子乞乞科夫购买死去农奴户籍以骗取贷款的讽刺故事。
books.description_en: A con man travels through Russia buying the ownership rights to dead serfs.

books.author: 亚历山大·普希金
books.description_zh: 俄国文学之父普希金的诗体小说，讲述贵族青年与乡村少女的爱情悲剧。
books.description_en: A verse novel about a world-weary aristocrat who rejects a young woman's love.

books.author: 米哈伊尔·莱蒙托夫
books.description_zh: 俄国拜伦式英雄佩乔林的高加索冒险，探索多余人的心灵。
books.description_en: The adventures of Pechorin, a Byronic hero in the Caucasus.

books.author: 伊万·屠格涅夫
books.description_zh: 虚无主义者巴扎罗夫与传统父辈的冲突，反映代际矛盾。
books.description_en: The conflict between nihilist youth and traditional elders in Russia.

books.author: 陀思妥耶夫斯基
books.description_zh: 地下室人的独白，探讨自由意志与理性的矛盾。
books.description_en: The monologue of a bitter, isolated man railing against rationalism.

books.author: 毗耶娑
books.description_zh: 世界最长史诗，讲述般度族与俱卢族的王位之争与俱卢大战。
books.description_en: The world's longest epic poem about the Kurukshetra War between the Pandavas and Kauravas.

books.author: 蚁垤
books.description_zh: 罗摩王子营救被魔王拉瓦那劫走的妻子悉多的史诗。
books.description_en: Prince Rama's quest to rescue his wife Sita from the demon king Ravana.

books.author: 毗耶娑
books.description_zh: 克里希纳神向阿周那阐述责任、行动与解脱的哲学对话。
books.description_en: A philosophical dialogue where Krishna counsels Arjuna on duty and liberation.

books.author: 迦梨陀娑
books.description_zh: 印度古典戏剧巅峰，讲述国王豆扇陀与仙女沙恭达罗的爱情。
books.description_en: A king falls in love with a hermit's foster daughter in this classic drama.

books.author: 迦梨陀娑
books.description_zh: 被流放的夜叉托云彩为信使，向爱人传递思念的抒情诗。
books.description_en: An exiled yaksha sends a message to his beloved through a cloud.

books.author: 毗湿奴沙尔曼
books.description_zh: 印度古代寓言故事集，通过动物故事传授处世智慧。
books.description_en: Ancient Indian collection of animal fables teaching practical wisdom.

books.author: 佚名
books.description_zh: 山鲁佐德用故事延续生命，讲述阿拉丁、辛巴达等神奇故事。
books.description_en: Scheherazade tells stories to survive, including tales of Aladdin and Sinbad.

books.author: 鲁米
books.description_zh: 苏菲派诗人鲁米的神秘主义诗集，被称为波斯语的古兰经。
books.description_en: Rumi's mystical poetry often called 'the Quran in Persian.'

books.author: 菲尔多西
books.description_zh: 波斯民族史诗，记述从神话时代到萨珊王朝的波斯历史。
books.description_en: The Persian national epic, chronicling the history of Persia from mythical times.

books.author: 萨迪
books.description_zh: 波斯古典文学明珠，诗文结合的道德寓言与人生智慧。
books.description_en: A collection of poems and stories offering moral wisdom and guidance.

books.author: 欧玛尔·海亚姆
books.description_zh: 四行诗集，歌颂美酒、爱情与生命的短暂。
books.description_en: Quatrains celebrating wine, love, and the fleeting nature of life.

books.author: 萨迪
books.description_zh: 萨迪的诗体道德教育著作，讲述正义、知足与修养。
books.description_en: A moral and ethical treatise in verse on justice, contentment, and virtue.

books.author: 伊本·穆加法
books.description_zh: 源自印度五卷书的动物寓言，两只豺狼的政治智慧故事。
books.description_en: Animal fables featuring two jackals, teaching political and worldly wisdom.

books.author: 法里德丁·阿塔尔
books.description_zh: 群鸟寻找神鸟西摩格的神秘主义寓言诗。
books.description_en: A mystical allegory of birds seeking the divine Simurgh.

books.author: 荷马
books.description_zh: 特洛伊战争中阿喀琉斯之怒的史诗，西方文学的源头。
books.description_en: The wrath of Achilles during the Trojan War, the foundation of Western literature.

books.author: 荷马
books.description_zh: 奥德修斯历经十年艰险返回故乡伊萨卡的冒险史诗。
books.description_en: Odysseus' decade-long journey home after the Trojan War.

books.author: 索福克勒斯
books.description_zh: 俄狄浦斯发现自己杀父娶母的命运悲剧。
books.description_en: Oedipus discovers he has killed his father and married his mother.

books.author: 索福克勒斯
books.description_zh: 安提戈涅违抗国王命令埋葬兄长的道德悲剧。
books.description_en: Antigone defies the king to bury her brother, choosing divine law over human law.

books.author: 埃斯库罗斯
books.description_zh: 普罗米修斯因盗火给人类而被宙斯惩罚的悲剧。
books.description_en: Prometheus is punished by Zeus for giving fire to humanity.

books.author: 埃斯库罗斯
books.description_zh: 阿伽门农家族的血腥复仇三部曲。
books.description_en: A trilogy about the cycle of vengeance in the House of Atreus.

books.author: 欧里庇得斯
books.description_zh: 美狄亚被伊阿宋抛弃后杀死自己孩子复仇的悲剧。
books.description_en: Medea takes terrible revenge when Jason abandons her for another woman.

books.author: 柏拉图
books.description_zh: 柏拉图的政治哲学巨著，探讨正义与理想国家。
books.description_en: Plato's exploration of justice and the ideal state through Socratic dialogue.

books.author: 维吉尔
books.description_zh: 特洛伊英雄埃涅阿斯建立罗马的史诗。
books.description_en: The Trojan hero Aeneas' journey to found the Roman nation.

books.author: 奥维德
books.description_zh: 250个希腊罗马神话中变形的故事，影响深远的神话百科。
books.description_en: 250 transformation myths from Greek and Roman mythology.

books.author: 奥古斯丁
books.description_zh: 奥古斯丁的灵魂自传，探索罪恶、恩典与皈依。
books.description_en: Augustine's spiritual autobiography exploring sin, grace, and conversion.

books.author: 卢克莱修
books.description_zh: 伊壁鸠鲁哲学的诗体阐述，关于原子、死亡与自然。
books.description_en: A poetic exposition of Epicurean philosophy on atoms, death, and nature.

books.author: 佚名
books.description_zh: 盎格鲁-撒克逊英雄贝奥武夫斩杀怪兽格伦德尔的史诗。
books.description_en: The Anglo-Saxon hero Beowulf battles the monster Grendel and a dragon.

books.author: 杰弗里·乔叟
books.description_zh: 去坎特伯雷朝圣的旅人们讲述的故事集，英国文学之父的杰作。
books.description_en: Stories told by pilgrims traveling to Canterbury, a masterpiece of medieval literature.

books.author: 约翰·弥尔顿
books.description_zh: 撒旦堕落与亚当夏娃失乐园的基督教史诗。
books.description_en: The fall of Satan and the expulsion of Adam and Eve from Eden.

books.author: 乔纳森·斯威夫特
books.description_zh: 格列佛游历小人国、大人国等奇异之地的讽刺小说。
books.description_en: Gulliver's voyages to Lilliput, Brobdingnag, and other strange lands.

books.author: 丹尼尔·笛福
books.description_zh: 鲁滨逊在荒岛上独自生存28年的冒险故事。
books.description_en: Robinson Crusoe's 28 years of survival on a deserted island.

books.author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
books.description_zh: 孤女简·爱与罗切斯特先生的爱情故事，探索女性独立。
books.description_en: The orphan Jane Eyre's romance with Mr. Rochester and her journey to independence.

books.author: 艾米莉·勃朗特
books.description_zh: 希斯克利夫与凯瑟琳的激情与复仇的哥特式爱情悲剧。
books.description_en: The passionate and destructive love between Heathcliff and Catherine.

books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.description_zh: 孤儿皮普从卑微到绅士的成长历程与幻灭。
books.description_en: The orphan Pip's journey from humble origins to becoming a gentleman.

books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.description_zh: 孤儿奥利弗在伦敦贫民窟的遭遇，揭露社会不公。
books.description_en: An orphan's struggles in London's criminal underworld.

books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.description_zh: 法国大革命背景下伦敦与巴黎两座城市的故事。
books.description_en: A story of love and sacrifice during the French Revolution.

books.author: 查尔斯·狄更斯
books.description_zh: 狄更斯最具自传色彩的小说，大卫从童年到成年的历程。
books.description_en: The most autobiographical of Dickens' novels, following David from childhood to maturity.

books.author: 托马斯·哈代
books.description_zh: 纯洁的农村女孩苔丝被社会偏见与命运摧毁的悲剧。
books.description_en: The tragic story of a pure country girl destroyed by fate and social prejudice.

books.author: 居斯塔夫·福楼拜
books.description_zh: 艾玛·包法利追求浪漫幻想却陷入婚外情与债务的悲剧。
books.description_en: Emma Bovary's pursuit of romantic fantasies leads to adultery and ruin.

books.author: 大仲马
books.description_zh: 水手唐泰斯被陷害入狱后化身伯爵复仇的传奇故事。
books.description_en: A sailor wrongly imprisoned escapes and exacts revenge as the Count of Monte Cristo.

books.author: 大仲马
books.description_zh: 达达尼昂与三个火枪手的友谊与冒险故事。
books.description_en: The adventures of d'Artagnan and his three musketeer friends.

books.author: 维克多·雨果
books.description_zh: 巴黎圣母院的钟楼怪人卡西莫多与吉普赛女郎艾斯梅拉达的悲剧。
books.description_en: The tragic story of Quasimodo, the bell-ringer of Notre-Dame, and the gypsy Esmeralda.

books.author: 司汤达
books.description_zh: 野心勃勃的平民于连·索雷尔在复辟时代法国的奋斗与悲剧。
books.description_en: The ambitious Julien Sorel's rise and fall in Restoration France.

books.author: 埃米尔·左拉
books.description_zh: 法国北部煤矿工人的罢工斗争，自然主义文学代表作。
books.description_en: A powerful depiction of a miners' strike in northern France.

books.author: 奥诺雷·德·巴尔扎克
books.description_zh: 老人高老头为两个忘恩负义的女儿倾尽所有的悲剧。
books.description_en: An old man sacrifices everything for his ungrateful daughters.

books.author: 伏尔泰
books.description_zh: 天真青年康德德经历种种灾难，讽刺莱布尼茨乐观主义。
books.description_en: A naive young man experiences disasters, satirizing philosophical optimism.

books.author: 夏尔·波德莱尔
books.description_zh: 波德莱尔的诗集，现代诗歌的先驱，探索美与恶。
books.description_en: Baudelaire's influential poetry collection exploring beauty and evil.

books.title_original: À la recherche du temps perdu
books.author: 马塞尔·普鲁斯特
books.description_zh: 通过非自主记忆探索时间、记忆与艺术的鸿篇巨著。
books.description_en: An exploration of time, memory, and art through involuntary memory.

books.author: 弗兰兹·卡夫卡
books.description_zh: 格里高尔一觉醒来变成大甲虫的荒诞故事。
books.description_en: Gregor Samsa wakes up transformed into a giant insect.

books.author: 弗兰兹·卡夫卡
books.description_zh: 约瑟夫·K被不明指控逮捕并审判的噩梦故事。
books.description_en: Josef K is arrested and prosecuted by an inaccessible authority.

books.author: 弗兰兹·卡夫卡
books.description_zh: 土地测量员K试图进入神秘城堡却永远无法接近。
books.description_en: A land surveyor struggles to gain access to a mysterious castle.

books.author: 托马斯·曼
books.description_zh: 吕贝克商人家族四代人的兴衰史。
books.description_en: The decline of a wealthy merchant family over four generations.
